jobs.title: Finance Operations Specialist H/F
jobs.description: At Marso, as a Finance Operations Specialist , you will keep the company’s day-to-day finances reliable, from invoices and payments to bookkeeping and monthly close. Working closely with the Head of Finance, you will structure and automate finance processes so that the numbers can be trusted, available quickly and ready to support Marso’s growth. Responsibilities Manage accounts payable: collect and process supplier invoices, check them against orders and receipts and prepare payment runs. Manage accounts receivable: customer invoicing, collections follow-up and cash receipts. Keep bookkeeping clean day to day: bank reconciliation, account matching, expense reports and supporting documents. Prepare the monthly close and the year-end close with the external accountant. Track cash and produce regular cash reports. Support management control: budget vs. actuals, cost allocation (R&D, COGS, CAPEX), and inventory and serial number tracking. Help manage public funding and tax credits (grants, CIR/CII), as well as payroll and HR inputs to finance. Structure and automate finance processes and tools. Profile 2 to 5 years of experience in accounting, finance operations, or management control, ideally in a startup, scale-up or industrial company. Solid accounting knowledge (French GAAP) and hands-on experience with monthly close processes. Proficiency with accounting and expense tools and advanced Excel skills. Taste for automation and process improvement. Professional English. Nice to have: experience in a hardware or industrial company (inventory, CAPEX, COGS), experience with CIR/CII or public funding, experience with an ERP. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background. jobs.description: About The Position: As Senior Finance & Controlling Officer, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening financial management across FZS's conservation programs in Africa. Working closely with local project teams, the Africa Department and headquarters, you will help develop effective financial structures, strengthen governance and establish sustainable processes that support the successful delivery of conservation objectives. Through collaboration, capacity building and the promotion of best practices, you will contribute to the continuous development of finance functions across the organization. Alongside this strategic focus, you will remain actively involved in selected controlling, accounting and reporting activities, providing hands-on support to project and program teams. Regular travel to African project countries is an integral part of your job. The position is part of the Finance Department at our headquarters in Frankfurt. After an initial onboarding period of approximately one year there, you will be permanently based at our office in Lusaka, Zambia, while staying closely connected to line management and processes in Frankfurt. Your Tasks: You analyze, optimize and harmonize finance, accounting, controlling and reporting processes across FZS's African project locations. You develop and implement practical standards, procedures, internal controls and best practices, while supporting continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives. You advise and support project managers and local finance teams on financial management, budget monitoring and reporting requirements. You review financial data and accounting records, coordinate international accounting processes and serve as a key contact for the ABACUS accounting system. You strengthen local financial capacities through training, knowledge sharing and the exchange of best practices across project locations.
